headline: Pro Consumidor carries out intervention at commercial establishments
summary: Pro Consumidor director Eddy Alcántara said the agency intervened in about 40 commercial establishments owned by Chinese nationals, with more than 20 showing irregularities that could lead to sanctions.
why: Pro Consumidor is the Dominican Republic's consumer protection regulator, and enforcement actions affect retailers' compliance costs.
original_headline: Pro Consumidor realiza intervención en establecimientos comerciales
